name: collab
description: Claude does not write code until the developer has proposed an approach, justified it, compared it with alternatives and confirmed the agreed solution in their own words (/collab:agree). Ends every unit of work with a technical review.

default_mode.title: Default collaboration mode
default_mode.description: learning: maximum depth of discussion and explanation; collaborative: balanced, for everyday work; review: the developer designs the solution, Claude reviews it. Switch per session with /collab:mode.
